function.name: detect_beats_and_filter
function.description: Analyzes an audio file to detect beats and filters them based on confidence levels and timing. Returns a list of times in seconds, each representing the occurrence of a significant beat within the audio file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

capture_percentage.description: Filters beats by excluding those below a specified confidence percentile. Values range from 0 to 100 (inclusive).

confidence_window_size.description: Selects the highest confidence beat within a given time window in seconds (e.g., 0.5), to ensure distinct beats are chosen in that period. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: User says "I dont want any beats". They likely want to filter out all beats? They might want to set capture_percentage to 0 or something. But the function expects capture_percentage between 0 and 100 inclusive. If we set capture_percentage to 0, it will exclude beats below 0 percentile? That would keep all beats? Actually "Filters beats by excluding those below a specified confidence percentile." So if capture_percentage=0, exclude beats below 0 percentile, meaning all beats are above 0 percentile, so none excluded. If we set capture_percentage=100, exclude beats below 100 percentile, meaning all beats are excluded. So to get no beats, set capture_percentage=100. Also we can set confidence_window_size maybe large to avoid selecting any? But if we exclude all beats, we get empty list. So we call function with capture_percentage=100, confidence_window_size maybe 0.5. Let's do that.
